Title: Entity / IEntity - Base Entity with ID
Summary: Base entity interface and abstract class providing a unique identifier for all persistent models in Cyréna.
Content:
## Entity / IEntity

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Models`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
Base entity interface and abstract class providing a unique identifier for all persistent models.

### IEntity Interface
```csharp
public interface IEntity
{
    string Id { get; set; }
}
```

### Entity Abstract Class
```csharp
public abstract class Entity : IEntity
{
    public virtual string Id { get; set; } = default!;
}
```

### Usage
All persistent models in Cyréna extend `Entity`:
- `ChatConfiguration`
- `Prompt`
- `ToolResult`
- Custom extension models

```csharp
public class MyModel : Entity
{
    public string Name { get; set; } = default!;
}
```

### Related
- `ChatConfiguration` - Chat settings model
- `Prompt` - System prompt model
- `IStore<T>` - Persistence contract requiring IEntity
